contracts: Two fixed profiles; explicit paths/raw source hashes; no client command/environment/resource overrides
Private captured runtime/source manifest/native versions and exact one-shot run_checks review
Durable intent before consume; close source pins before terminal journal; retained uncertain native results
Native namespaces/read-only consumed mount FDs/sealed thread-only filter/fixed inherited CPU/resource/output policy
Actual timeout/cancel/launch-ack/group-signal fallback/join and no surviving native process
Exact bounded raw output with base64/hash/count/EOF; forged exit0 never implies functional quality
Actual local TCP existing CLI concrete typed fixture review then separate explicit run
Actual ASGI lost response retains actual result/consumed state without replay
Actual SIGKILL at captured/starting/after-exit-before-terminal stages; no recovered grants or inferred observation
Actual startup failure/cancel drains checks before checkpoint/approval/workspace
limitations: Single process, ephemeral proposals/approvals; no old-grant resume/refund/retry
Explicit existing eligible Python files only; stdlib unittest/Ruff, no supported third-party framework/subprocess workflow
Readonly trusted /usr remains visible; private runtime hashes are not a hermetic immutable OS image
Address-space/CPU/thread/FD/file/tmpfs/wall/output limits are not a measured RSS/VRAM or whole-kernel bound
Native exit/output is untrusted observation, not general quality proof
Cooperating source/native fences are not a hostile same-UID atomic multi-file CAS or all crash/power-loss guarantee
No production workspace/root/feature/job or action approved
